findings: Independently read pre-IPO section (pp112-121) and full board roster (pp190-196). Only non-executive Director Yu Lijie is linked: general manager of Zhejiang/Zheshang Business Venture Capital Management (Shenzhen), the fund manager/GP of pre-IPO investors Taolue New Energy, Taolue Xinwang and Jinlan Sunshine (14.86%). The English romanisation differs (Zheshang vs Zhejiang) between p194 and p116 but the Chinese name 浙商創業投資管理(深圳)有限公司 is identical; p189 also states Zhejiang Business Venture is the general partner of the three funds. Other directors (5 execs, 3 INEDs incl. Zhong Luhuan, ex-Hony, partner at Zhonghong Jin Kong) have no stated link. Candidate quotes verified verbatim (including p189 table quote) with correct printed-page mapping; candidate interpretation follows the standard (person is officer of the investor's GP/manager). Candidate correctly flags that nomination by investor is not stated and that his role is described without an end date.
residual_uncertainty: Prospectus never says Yu Lijie was nominated by the investors, and no board-appointment right is listed among special rights; continuing employment at Zheshang Business Venture at listing is inferred from a bio with no end date ('From March 2013 ... general manager'). Link between the two romanisations rests on identical Chinese name. Series A closed 30 Nov 2020, appointment 30 Dec 2020 fits investor-driven appointment but is inference.
